title: Surreal AI Official Music Video - Flying With My Dreams - Kelly Boesch | 4K
description:
I wanted this one to feel a bit dreamy. I love the contrast of the fish in the desert. The song is about refusing to lose your inner child. It’s called “Flying With My Dreams”, which symbolizes transcendence. Choosing feeling over logic, imagination over cynicism, and innocence over hardness. Staying tender and curious ❤️. Images made using #Midjourney and animated using #Midjourney. Song made using @suno  

#ai #aiart #aivideo #aimusic #suno #aiimages #surreal #dreams
